```yaml
name: Manual Plugin Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version_increment:
        description: 'Select version increment type'
        required: true
        options:
          - major
          - minor
          - patch

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Get current version
        id: get_version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(jq -r '.version' package.json)"

      - name: Increment version
        id: increment_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(echo ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }})
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "major" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1+1".0.0"}'))
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "minor" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1"."$2+1".0"}'))
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "patch" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1"."$2"."$3+1}'))
          fi
          echo "::set-output name=new_version::$NEW_VERSION"

      - name: Update version in package.json
        run: sed -i '' "s/\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"/\"version\": \"$NEW_VERSION\"/" package.json

      - name: Commit version update
        run: git commit -am "chore(release): bump version to $NEW_VERSION"

      - name: Create Git tag
        run: git tag v$NEW_VERSION

      - name: Push changes and tags
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
          tags: true

      - name: Trigger release workflow
        id: trigger_release
        uses: pascalgn/trigger-workflow-action@master
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          owner: Nexus-JPF
          repo: note-companion
          workflow: "release.yml"
          ref: main
          inputs: '{"version": "'$NEW_VERSION'"}'
```

on:

        required: true

jobs:

    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v2

        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Get current version
        id: get_version
        run: echo "::set-output name=version::$(jq -r '.version' package.json)"

      - name: Increment version
        id: increment_version
        run: |
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(echo ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }})
          if [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "major" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1+1".0.0"}'))
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "minor" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1"."$2+1".0"}'))
          elif [ "${{ github.event.inputs.version_increment }}" == "patch" ]; then
            NEW_VERSION=$(npm version --no-git-tag-version $(echo $CURRENT_VERSION | awk -F"." '{print $1"."$2"."$3+1}'))
          fi
          echo "::set-output name=new_version::$NEW_VERSION"

      - name: Update version in package.json

      - name: Commit version update
        run: git commit -am "chore(release): bump version to $NEW_VERSION"

      - name: Create Git tag
        run: git tag v$NEW_VERSION

      - name: Push changes and tags
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0

          owner: Nexus-JPF
          repo: note-companion
          workflow: "release.yml"
          ref: main
          inputs: '{"version": "'$NEW_VERSION'"}'
